title: System Explorer hub host directory
description: Every host a site hub can reach, plus each sibling site's own local view — the estate as one document, federated exactly one hop deep. This is the hub's only aggregating route; everything else it serves is a verbatim proxy of an agent's own envelope. Reachability is data, not an error: a dark agent is a host entry saying so, and a dark sibling is a SITE entry saying so, because 'no hosts there' and 'cannot see there' are different statements and only one of them is a problem. The hub is stateless and holds no cache, so this document is what was true at observed_at and nothing older. Shared $defs are duplicated from observation.schema.json deliberately so each schema file is standalone.

site.description: This hub's own site name, or null when the deployment did not configure one. A hub without a site can still serve its agents; it cannot federate, because a sibling's entries are keyed by site.

hosts.description: Agent name -> reachability. Includes hosts learned from siblings, carrying the site that owns them; a local host wins a name collision, because this hub can verify its own.

sites.description: Site name -> that site's reachability and the host names it claims. Present when this hub knows its own site; absent on a hub with neither a site nor siblings.

hostEntry.description: Reachable means the agent answered /health and can be dialled at url; unreachable means it did not, and says what went wrong.

host.description: The agent's own identity as it reported it. Absent when the agent answered without identifying itself — which is a different statement from an agent that could not be reached at all.

url.description: Where this hub dials the agent. SITE-INTERNAL: a URL from one site's hub is not necessarily dialable from another, which is why a cross-site consumer goes through the owning hub's proxy routes rather than dialling agents directly.

error.description: Why the agent could not be reached, bounded by system_explorer.text.one_line.

allOf.description: A reachable agent names where it was reached.
An unreachable agent says why. Silence would read as an empty site.

siteEntry.description: local is this hub's own site, learned first-hand; a non-local site was asked for its own local view with ?local=1, which is what makes federation exactly one hop deep and cannot be followed by another hop.

url.description: The sibling hub. Absent on the local site, which needs no URL to reach itself.

hosts.description: The host names this site claims, sorted. Names only — their entries live in the top-level hosts map.

allOf.description: A reachable site contributed its host names, even if that list is empty.
A dark site says why, and is reported as a site rather than silently contributing nothing.

registryName.description: An operator-chosen name from SE_HUB_AGENTS / SE_HUB_SIBLINGS, not a native identifier.
